symptom: comments.mjs trimmed JSX text lines with / +$/, which rescans a space run from every position: 100 KB of spaces before a non-space took 7 s, and doubling it quadrupled the time. Review of #790 had already found four such patterns in transcript.mjs that lint analysis missed.
rule: Every regular expression in scripts/zstack must scan crafted input in linear time; scripts/zstack/linear-regex.mjs times each one against generic shapes and its own literal words at two sizes. Restore the / +$/ trim in jsxText.
